title: 第十三章 携美理政第十四章 金陵来客
content_zh:
马车中，陆宁坐在面对车厢门的正首位置，甘氏和尤五娘一左一右坐在旁侧榻上。
尤五娘水汪汪凤目转呀转的，突然便轻轻撩起裙裾，一对儿红彤彤小绣花鞋伸过去便夹住了正襟危坐的甘氏裙裾下那对儿粉色小绣花鞋，盘她双足出来，娇笑道：“主人，好像贵儿比我的脚小一些，是不是？”
甘氏俏脸立时满是红霞，奋力将双足挣回，藏在裙裾下。
陆宁咳嗽一声：“不许胡闹！”
“是！”尤五娘便乖乖坐好。
两个美娇娘一左一右陪着，而且，都是自己的婢妾，车厢内花香醉人，陆宁觉得，自己再不找个话题，任由尤五娘这小you物控场，怕不知道会不会走偏，一会儿就变成满车春光。
琢磨着，陆宁心里突然一哂，却是不知不觉，真的将她俩当自己的妾侍，或者说，当作自己的女朋友看了，不过，这也没什么不好，两个都是冰雪聪明善解人意，各有各的可人之处，若说自己不喜欢，那是自欺欺人，有这样两位红颜陪伴自己在这古人世界走上一遭，却没那么寂寞了。
……
甘氏和尤五娘都没想到，陆宁领着两人来了府衙。
这府衙，正在修葺扩充中，有半边府邸都竖起了木架子。
另一半衙门，则仍在对外运转。
现今衙门承袭唐制，早晚两班，早衙从七点左右到十一点，晚衙从七点到九点左右。
不过下午时分，也有胥吏轮流当值，今日当值的正是刘汉常。
见到国主领着两个美妾前来，刘汉常慌忙跪迎，尤其有尤五娘在，刘汉常就更是心里胆突突，根本不敢抬头。
尤五娘见他样子，心中只是冷笑，真想问他一句：“呦，这不是刘佐史吗？现在认得我家主君了？”
不过，主君地位崇高，而且，有一种视万户侯为粪土的超然，她这个婢妾，自也要学着眼界更高一些，刘汉常这等蝼蚁，和他计较做甚？
“把我昨天叫你找的卷宗拿出来，我要审阅几个案子，还有，提审那童九！”
听国主第下的话，刘汉常一呆，这才知道国主是带着美妾来坐堂处理国事，不过，在这东海国内，莫说带着婢妾坐堂，就算掀翻了天，谁能管的了国主？
甘氏和尤五娘，也都是一怔。
“是。”刘汉常恭恭敬敬的说。

向厅堂走着，陆宁顺口道：“对了，刘汉常，以后，你便是公府右侍郎，掌兵法士。”
刘汉常身子一抖，那一瞬，就觉得无穷无尽的幸福包裹了他，鼻子酸酸的，立时用力磕头，哽咽道：“小的，不，臣从此为主公效死命！”他是真的呜咽了，从此，他再不是小小的吏员，而是有了品级的正式官员，这种身份的跨越，几乎如同天堑。
“不过，你若还是以前那般行事，出了纰漏，莫怪我摘了你的脑袋！”
陆宁进厅堂前这轻飘飘一句话，又令刘汉常身子一颤，全身冷汗沁出。
……
厅堂里，陆宁将一些卷宗随意的交给甘氏和尤五娘看。
两个美娇娘都有些懵，但陆宁让她们看，就只好坐在一旁翻阅。
陆宁也是无奈之举，东海县是上县，五六万人口，大大小小的事务太多了，手下又几乎没什么信得过的，如果所有大事都要他搞得明明白白最后做决定，怕是要累死。
自己眼前第一要务，是挑选人手，训练亲兵不是？
反而现在，比较值得信任的倒是甘氏和尤五娘两个女人，如果她们谁有理政能力，幕后帮自己处理政事也不错。
幸好，两人出身都不错，都同样冰雪聪明，识文断字。
尤五娘懒散些，识得字没甘夫人多，但终究还是能看明白公文意思的。
现今，看着甘氏和尤五娘两个千娇百媚的大美女很认真的翻阅文书，自己在这里翘着脚喝茶，眼前赏心悦目，心里，奴役两个女友帮自己干活，更是惬意的很。
脚步声响，却是刘汉常领着几名差役，将那自称“童九”的大汉带了进来。
铁塔似汉子，看来也饿的没了力气，本来站得笔直，被几名差役踹了膝弯，轻轻松松就跪下了。
“你说来此寻亲？你的亲人是胞妹？童十三？”陆宁看着卷宗，问。
大汉低着头，并不言语，显然，他已经心死了。
陆宁还是看着其供述，说：“你说你胞妹自小跟一名女真人修仙？最后一次给你去信，说是她正跟仙师在海州慈云庵修行？”
本来正认真看一个案子卷宗的尤五娘，猛地抬起了头。
大汉还是不吱声。

陆宁无奈道：“你什么都不说，我可帮不到你了。”
“某供述句句为真！”大汉终于吭声了。
陆宁微微蹙眉，心说，要派人去海州慈云庵查一查么？
content_en:
In the carriage, Lu Ning sat at the front facing the carriage door, while Gan and You Wuniang sat on the couches on the left and right.
You Wuniang's watery eyes turned around, and she suddenly lifted up the skirt of her skirt. She stretched out a pair of small red embroidered shoes and clamped the pair of small pink embroidered shoes under the skirt of Gan who was sitting upright. He came out with her feet wrapped around her and said with a sweet smile: "Master, it seems that your feet are smaller than mine, isn't it?"
Gan's pretty face was immediately filled with red clouds. She struggled to get her feet back and hid them under her skirt.
Lu Ning coughed: "No nonsense!"
"Yes!" You Wuniang sat down obediently.
Two beauties were accompanying him on the left and right, and they were both his maids and concubines. The fragrance of flowers in the carriage was intoxicating. Lu Ning felt that if he didn't find a topic and let the little creature You Wuniang control the situation, he was afraid that he might go astray, and the carriage would soon become full of love.
Thinking about it, Lu Ning suddenly thought, but unknowingly, he really regarded the two of them as his concubines, or in other words, as his girlfriends. However, there is nothing wrong with this. Both of them are smart and considerate, and they each have their own lovable qualities. If you say you don't like them, you are deceiving yourself. With such two beauties accompanying you in this ancient world, you feel less lonely.
…
Neither Gan nor You Wuniang expected that Lu Ning would lead them to the government office.
This government office is under renovation and expansion, and half of the mansion has wooden shelves erected.
The other half of the yamen are still operating externally.
Today's yamen follow the Tang Dynasty system, with two shifts in the morning and evening. The morning yamen is from about 7 to 11 o'clock, and the evening yamen is from about 7 to 9 o'clock.
However, in the afternoon, there were also subordinate staff who took turns on duty, and it was Liu Hanchang who was on duty today.
Seeing the lord of the country coming with his two beautiful concubines, Liu Hanchang hurriedly knelt down to greet him. Especially with You Wuniang there, Liu Hanchang was even more frightened and did not dare to raise his head at all.
Seeing his appearance, You Wuniang just sneered in her heart. She really wanted to ask him: "Hey, isn't this Liu Zuoshi? Do you recognize my master now?"
However, the master's status is lofty, and there is a kind of detachment that treats the princes of ten thousand households as rubbish. She, a maid and concubine, must learn to have a higher vision. Why should an ant like Liu Hanchang care about him?
"Take out the files I asked you to find yesterday. I want to review a few cases and interrogate that Tong Jiu!"
Liu Hanchang was stunned when he heard the words of the king. Only then did he realize that the king brought his concubine to sit in court to handle state affairs. However, in the East China Sea, not to mention sitting in court with his concubine, even if the sky was overturned, who could control the king?
Gan and You Wuniang were also startled.
"Yes." Liu Hanchang said respectfully.
Walking towards the hall, Lu Ning said smoothly: "By the way, Liu Hanchang, from now on, you will be the right minister of the Duke's palace and the military magician."
Liu Hanchang shuddered, and at that moment, he felt endless happiness wrapped around him. His nose was sour, and he immediately kowtowed hard and choked: "My dear, no, I will serve my lord to the death from now on!" He really sobbed. From then on, he was no longer a small official, but a formal official with a rank. This kind of identity leap was almost like a natural chasm.
"However, if you still act like before and make mistakes, don't blame me for taking off your head!"
Lu Ning's soft words before entering the hall made Liu Hanchang tremble again, and cold sweat broke out all over his body.
…
In the hall, Lu Ning casually handed some files to Gan and You Wuniang to read.
The two beauties were a little confused, but Lu Ning asked them to read it, so they had no choice but to sit aside and read through it.
Lu Ning also had no choice but to do it. Donghai County is a Shang County with a population of fifty to sixty thousand. There are too many large and small matters, and there are almost no trustworthy subordinates. If he had to figure out all major matters clearly and make the final decision, he would be exhausted.
His first priority is to select manpower and train his own soldiers, right?
On the contrary, now, the ones who are more trustworthy are Gan and You Wuniang.A woman, if any of them has the ability to manage politics, it would be good to help her handle political affairs behind the scenes.
Fortunately, both of them came from good backgrounds, were equally intelligent and literate.
You Wuniang is lazy and not as literate as Mrs. Gan, but she can still understand the meaning of official documents.
Now, seeing Gan and You Wuniang, two charming beauties, carefully reading through the documents, I am drinking tea with my feet up here. It is pleasing to the eye, and in my heart, it is even more satisfying to enslave two girlfriends to help me work.
There was a sound of footsteps, but it was Liu Hanchang who led a few servants and brought in the big man who called himself "Tong Jiu".
The iron tower looked like a man, and he seemed to have lost his strength due to hunger. He was standing upright, but his knees were kicked by several guards, and he knelt down easily.
"You said you came here to find relatives? Your relative is your sister? Tong Shisan?" Lu Ning looked at the file and asked.
The big man lowered his head and said nothing. It was obvious that he was heartbroken.
Lu Ning still looked at her confession and said, "You said that your sister has been cultivating immortals with a Jurchen since she was a child? The last time I wrote to you, she said that she was practicing with the immortal master at Ciyun Temple in Haizhou?"
You Wuniang, who was reading a case file seriously, suddenly raised her head.
The big man still said nothing.
Lu Ning said helplessly: "If you don't say anything, I can't help you."
"Every statement I made is true!" The big man finally said.
Lu Ning frowned slightly and thought to himself, should he send someone to Haizhou Ciyun Temple to check?
